messages.body: We can support 3.5x on the add-on at current pricing. Term sheet to follow.
Can you lead the management meeting? I will join for the first hour.
Call recordings show missed booking chances after hours. We want the answering pilot on all four hubs.
Send me the results from the pilot hub first.
Crews are losing time waiting on material at two sites. We are trying staged deliveries.
Open roles on the service desk are slowing first-level resolution. Hiring plan attached.
Center 3 fill rate is the lowest of the three. Slotting changes start this week.
Can you set the next round of company check-ins? Two hours each, KPIs first.
Swim returns are mostly sizing. The fit guide test is live on two products.
Still missing: customer list by revenue, lease schedule and the payroll register. I sent a reminder to the banker.
